'''Whorh''' was an [[Ansion/Legends|Ansonian]] deity who [[Kyakhta]] believed in. Ansonians sometimes referred to ''the winds of whorh ''as the will of ''benevolent fate'', ''good'' ''luck'' or ''fortune''.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
